probes.question: How long after launch did Ariane 5 flight 501 veer off its flight path?
True or false: the Ariane 5 reused code from the Ariane 4.

image.alt: Illustration of a rocket veering away from its dotted straight path into a night sky

panels.text: 4 June 1996: the failed maiden flight of the Ariane 5 rocket. It carried the Cluster spacecraft, a constellation of four European Space Agency research satellites.
The Ariane 5 reused the code from the inertial reference platform from the Ariane 4, but its early flight path had higher horizontal velocity values.
A data conversion from a 64-bit floating point number to a 16-bit signed integer overflowed and caused a hardware exception.
The rocket veered off its flight path 37 seconds after launch and began to disintegrate.
